hero.title: A focused desktop media downloader.
hero.desc: Save video, audio, images, and multi-image posts from YouTube, Instagram, X, TikTok, Reddit, Bluesky, and hundreds of other sites when you are authorized to save them.

downloads.label: Downloads
downloads.title: Choose your installer.
downloads.desc: Official builds are loaded directly from the latest GitHub release.
downloads.notInRelease: Installer pending in the latest release.
downloads.couldNotLoad: Release details are unavailable. View GitHub for status.

features.label: Capabilities
features.title: The control you need. Nothing you do not.
features.desc: Analyze links, choose formats, and manage downloads without working in a terminal.
features.anyMediaDesc: Paste a link and the app recognizes what it holds: a video lists its qualities, audio lists its formats, and an image post shows every image to choose from.
features.sizesDesc: Every option shows its real size and format, from 4K video to original-quality audio.
features.searchDesc: Search YouTube, SoundCloud, Bilibili, Niconico, Reddit, Bluesky, and more, then queue several results at once.
features.queueDesc: Downloads run a few at a time with pause, resume, retry, and cancel. Finished files move to History.
features.cookiesDesc: For sites that need an account, import cookies exported from your own browser profile. Each site's cookies are sent only to that site.
features.updatesDesc: The media engines update from their official releases and are verified against published checksums. On Windows and Linux, the app also installs its own updates.

screenshots.label: Interface
screenshots.title: Made to stay out of your way.
screenshots.desc: Captures of version 1.1.0 in its dark theme.
screenshots.homeCaption: Preview a link with every quality and its exact size.
screenshots.galleryCaption: Choose which images to keep from a multi-image post.
screenshots.searchCaption: Search a site and queue several results at once.
screenshots.queueCaption: Follow running and queued downloads in one place.

workflow.label: Workflow
workflow.title: From link to file in four steps.
workflow.step1Desc: Run the installer. The media engines are ready on first launch.
workflow.step2Desc: Paste a link from a supported site, or search for one.
workflow.step3Desc: Pick the quality, format, images, and destination.
workflow.step4Desc: Follow progress in the queue. Finished files appear in History.

releaseNotes.coreDesc: Electron, a Node.js runtime, and checksum-verified yt-dlp and gallery-dl builds are included.
releaseNotes.ffmpegDesc: Install it for high-quality stream merging, MP3 conversion, metadata, and frame captures.
releaseNotes.unsignedDesc: Builds are not commercially code-signed, so your system may show a warning on first install. Later updates install from within the app on Windows and Linux.

trust.label: System & trust
trust.title: Know exactly what you are installing.
trust.desc: Desktop Media Downloader is open source, requires no app account, and keeps its history, settings, and imported cookies in local application storage.
trust.responsibleDesc: Only download media you are authorized to save. The app is not intended to bypass DRM, paywalls, or access controls.
trust.browserDesc: No cookies are used unless you import them. Imported cookies stay on your device and are sent only to the site they belong to.

footer.projectDescription: Small tools for better desktop workflows.
footer.warning: Open-source builds are not currently commercially code-signed. Verify downloads against the official GitHub release.
